answer: A hostile operator running 22 aliases therefore needs 88 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in onyx, expire in horizon, and kernel lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 171 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
